answer: Admission is a per-epoch Dutch auction priced in single-use compute certificates: one clearing price, payable only as signed GPU-work attestations bound to one new key, burned on use. Incumbents pay nothing; each seat pays the same price. A sybil running N puppets pays N times - certificates cannot be pooled, resold, or carried over, so identity has no bulk discount. Fairness is auditable only on the auction mesa - price, seats, burn log - a prism splitting revenue from puppet churn; each burn leaves an ember record, exposing any attacker whose cost dips below linear.
